[SWS_DM_01261] Validation of Invalid Session Level in ara::diag::Conversation::GetDiagnosticSessionShortName
⌈
If
the
application calls ara::diag::Conversation::GetDiagnosticSessionShort-
Name with the parameter session set to a value that is not equal to any configured
DiagnosticSession in the DiagnosticContributionSet, the Diagnostic
Server instance shall return error code kInvalidArgument.
⌋
